The groups of a store

Source: R/dataset.R
zaro_groups.Rd

Lists every group of a Zarr store, the root included, with the number of arrays directly in each, so a nested product can be opened one group at a time with zaro_dataset(group = ). Uses consolidated metadata when the root has it (one request); otherwise lists the store, which needs a store that can be listed (not plain HTTP).

Usage

zaro_groups(source, verbose = zaro_verbose(), ...)

Arguments

source

a store from zaro(), or a character source passed to zaro() along with ....

verbose

logical. Emit diagnostic messages. Default getOption("zaro.verbose", TRUE).

...

passed to zaro() when source is character.

Value

A data frame with columns group (path, "" for the root) and arrays (number of arrays directly in the group), sorted by path.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
eopf_url <- paste0(
  "https://s3.explorer.eopf.copernicus.eu/esa-zarr-sentinel-explorer-fra/",
  "tests-output/sentinel-2-l2a/",
  "S2C_MSIL2A_20260120T084301_N0511_R064_T36UXA_20260120T122910.zarr")
zaro_groups(eopf_url)
} # }
